"todo/store.py":'''"""JSON file store for todo items."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional, Union

DEFAULT_FILENAME = "todos.json"


class TodoError(Exception):
    """Raised for user-facing errors (bad title, unknown id, ...)."""


@dataclass
class Item:
    id: int
    title: str
    done: bool = False
    created_at: str = ""


def default_path() -> Path:
    """TODO_FILE env var, else todos.json in the repo root."""
    env = os.environ.get("TODO_FILE")
    if env:
        return Path(env)
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / DEFAULT_FILENAME


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None):
        self.path = Path(path) if path is not None else default_path()

    # -- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
    def _load(self) -> dict:
        if not self.path.exists():
            return {"next_id": 1, "items": []}
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") or "{}")
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise TodoError(f"corrupt store {self.path}: {e}") from e
        data.setdefault("items", [])
        data.setdefault("next_id", max((i["id"] for i in data["items"]), default=0) + 1)
        return data

    def _save(self, data: dict) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(self.path.parent), prefix=".todos-", suffix=".tmp")
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
                f.write("\\n")
            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
        except BaseException:
            if os.path.exists(tmp):
                os.unlink(tmp)
            raise

    # -- operations --------------------------------------------------------
    def add(self, title: str) -> Item:
        title = (title or "").strip()
        if not title:
            raise TodoError("title must not be empty")
        data = self._load()
        item = Item(
            id=data["next_id"],
            title=title,
            done=False,
            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        )
        data["items"].append(asdict(item))
        data["next_id"] += 1
        self._save(data)
        return item

    def list(self, include_done: bool = True) -> List[Item]:
        items = [Item(**i) for i in self._load()["items"]]
        return items if include_done else [i for i in items if not i.done]

    def complete(self, item_id: int) -> Item:
        data = self._load()
        for raw in data["items"]:
            if raw["id"] == item_id:
                if raw["done"]:
                    raise TodoError(f"todo {item_id} is already complete")
                raw["done"] = True
                self._save(data)
                return Item(**raw)
        raise TodoError(f"no todo with id {item_id}")
''',
"todo/cli.py":'''"""argparse entry point: add, list, complete."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from typing import List, Optional

from todo.store import Store, TodoError


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="todo", description="A tiny JSON-backed todo list.")
    p.add_argument("--file", help="path to the JSON store (default: $TODO_FILE or todos.json in the repo)")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    a = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a todo")
    a.add_argument("title", nargs="+", help="todo text")

    ls = sub.add_parser("list", help="list open todos")
    ls.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="include completed todos")

    c = sub.add_parser("complete", help="mark a todo done")
    c.add_argument("id", type=int, help="todo id")
    return p


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    store = Store(args.file)
    try:
        if args.command == "add":
            item = store.add(" ".join(args.title))
            print(f"Added #{item.id}: {item.title}")
        elif args.command == "list":
            items = store.list(include_done=args.all)
            if not items:
                print("No todos.")
            for i in items:
                print(f"[{'x' if i.done else ' '}] {i.id}. {i.title}")
        elif args.command == "complete":
            item = store.complete(args.id)
            print(f"Completed #{item.id}: {item.title}")
    except TodoError as e:
        print(f"error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    sys.exit(main())
''',

"tests/test_store.py":'''import json

import pytest

from todo.store import Store, TodoError


def test_missing_file_is_empty(tmp_path):
    assert Store(tmp_path / "none.json").list() == []


def test_add_persists_and_assigns_ids(tmp_path):
    s = Store(tmp_path / "t.json")
    a, b = s.add("one"), s.add("  two  ")
    assert (a.id, b.id) == (1, 2)
    assert b.title == "two"
    data = json.loads((tmp_path / "t.json").read_text())
    assert data["next_id"] == 3
    assert [i["title"] for i in data["items"]] == ["one", "two"]
    assert Store(tmp_path / "t.json").list()[0].title == "one"


def test_add_rejects_empty(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(TodoError):
        Store(tmp_path / "t.json").add("   ")


def test_complete_and_filter(tmp_path):
    s = Store(tmp_path / "t.json")
    s.add("a"); s.add("b")
    assert s.complete(1).done is True
    assert [i.id for i in s.list(include_done=False)] == [2]
    assert [i.id for i in s.list()] == [1, 2]


def test_complete_errors(tmp_path):
    s = Store(tmp_path / "t.json")
    s.add("a")
    with pytest.raises(TodoError, match="no todo"):
        s.complete(99)
    s.complete(1)
    with pytest.raises(TodoError, match="already"):
        s.complete(1)


def test_corrupt_file_raises(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "t.json"
    p.write_text("{nope")
    with pytest.raises(TodoError, match="corrupt"):
        Store(p).list()


def test_no_temp_files_left(tmp_path):
    Store(tmp_path / "t.json").add("a")
    assert sorted(x.name for x in tmp_path.iterdir()) == ["t.json"]
''',
"tests/test_cli.py":'''import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from todo.cli import main

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def test_add(store_path, capsys):
    assert main(["add", "buy", "milk"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "Added #1: buy milk"
    assert store_path.exists()


def test_add_empty_title_fails(store_path, capsys):
    assert main(["add", " "]) == 1
    assert "title must not be empty" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_list_empty(store_path, capsys):
    assert main(["list"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "No todos."


def test_list_hides_done_unless_all(store_path, capsys):
    main(["add", "a"]); main(["add", "b"]); main(["complete", "1"])
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert main(["list"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines() == ["[ ] 2. b"]
    assert main(["list", "--all"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines() == ["[x] 1. a", "[ ] 2. b"]


def test_complete(store_path, capsys):
    main(["add", "a"])
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert main(["complete", "1"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "Completed #1: a"


def test_complete_unknown_id(store_path, capsys):
    assert main(["complete", "42"]) == 1
    assert "no todo with id 42" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_complete_twice(store_path, capsys):
    main(["add", "a"]); main(["complete", "1"])
    assert main(["complete", "1"]) == 1
    assert "already complete" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_file_flag_overrides_env(store_path, tmp_path, capsys):
    other = tmp_path / "other.json"
    assert main(["--file", str(other), "add", "x"]) == 0
    assert other.exists() and not store_path.exists()


def test_missing_command_errors():
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as e:
        main([])
    assert e.value.code == 2


def test_python_dash_m_end_to_end(tmp_path):
    env = {**os.environ, "TODO_FILE": str(tmp_path / "t.json"), "PYTHONPATH": str(REPO)}
    run = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "todo", *a], env=env,
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=tmp_path)
    assert run("add", "hello").stdout.strip() == "Added #1: hello"
    assert run("complete", "1").returncode == 0
    assert run("list", "--all").stdout.strip() == "[x] 1. hello"
    bad = run("complete", "7")
    assert bad.returncode == 1 and "no todo" in bad.stderr

"README.md":'''# todo

A tiny command-line todo app. It uses only the Python standard library (3.9+) and stores todos in a JSON file.

## Usage

```sh
python -m todo add "buy milk"      # Added #1: buy milk
python -m todo add call mom        # extra words are joined into one title
python -m todo list                # open todos only
python -m todo list --all          # include completed ones
python -m todo complete 1          # Completed #1: buy milk
```

After `pip install -e .` the same commands work as `todo add ...` and so on.

Exit codes: 0 means success, 1 means a todo error (empty title, unknown id, already complete, corrupt store), and 2 means bad arguments.

## Storage

By default todos live in `todos.json` at the repo root. To use another file, set the `TODO_FILE` env var or pass `--file PATH` before the command:

```sh
python -m todo --file ~/work.json list
```

Format:

```json
{"next_id": 2, "items": [{"id": 1, "title": "buy milk", "done": false, "created_at": "2026-10-28T07:00:00+00:00"}]}
```

IDs are never reused. Writes are atomic: the store writes a temp file, then renames it over the old one.

## Tests

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[test]'
.venv/bin/pytest
```
''',

for k,v in files.items(): print(k, write_file(R+k, v).get("error"))
